  PROBLEM: The new escalation-keep rule restores a judged `escalate_human` when the linked PR is closed or merged, and it does not check `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION`. This is an undocumented second exception to that flag.
  WHY: With the default `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION=false`, the escalation reaches the escalate_human arm, which adds `ai:needs-human` and increments the recovery counter (or pauses stall recovery). README.md:311 / README.md:2575 document a downgrade with only the `MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY` exception. Both reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash said they considered this item and chose not to raise it, because the behaviour is what #9482 asks for and the last run did not touch these lines.

  WHY: The merged signal is split across two fields. Fix: set `pr_merged="true"` in the fallback branch (1 line).
